verdict.rationale: Recurly is a SaaS billing platform, so an in-product AI assistant is a fair axis to ask about, but the evidence shows no built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The Compass MCP server lets external agents such as Claude Desktop or Cursor connect to Recurly's docs and APIs, which is a different role. Churn propensity modeling is an ML scoring feature, not an assistant that takes on tasks.
